read_by: Agent-drafted, from the cell's own tier table and capability declaration
input: 3-second gust at array height (mph), 0 to 200 (warn or clamp), turned into a demand ratio: (gust / design gust) squared times stow and zone multipliers
not_covered: The other 36% of the reference physical base (parts not named by the cell) has no curve or value share; the cell says this is not an automatic zero
out_of_scope: Tornado and windborne debris (deferred to a separate pathway)
Yearly and tail loss metrics (computed by the consumer, not the cell)
missing_mechanisms: Cascade between racking or tracker failure and module detachment (no dependency rule)
next_version: Proposed model v2.0 (docs r1): straight-line convective wind only, separate fixed-tilt and qualified single-axis-tracker records with architecture-specific demand axes, bounded cascade, explicit value linkage and known-answer tests; T4 screening proxy, not canonical

how_to_use.share_of: Replacement value of the same part, as a share of the physical replaceable base (default shares are illustrative)

outputs.scenario_dollars: conditional: needs an explicit value and exposure basis
outputs.yearly_loss: conditional: computed by the consumer from a frequency-driven loss simulation with caps applied; curve spread not carried

conditions: Compute the demand ratio once; do not apply zone or terrain multipliers twice
Multiply each damage ratio only by the same part's non-overlapping value
Tornado and debris damage are not in this aerodynamic curve

method.summary: Thresholded logistic curves on a design-normalised demand ratio; axis from wind-pressure physics, all numeric parameters set by engineering judgment from PV wind-load and storm-resilience sources

key_sources: Wind-pressure physics, pressure scales with speed squared (WIND_PRESSURE_PHYSICS)
CPP, torsional instability of single-axis trackers (CPP_TORSIONAL_TRACKER)
judgment: Damage thresholds, midpoints and slopes for every part are engineering fits
Damage caps per part (15% to 80%) are engineering fits, not claims-calibrated
Default part value shares are illustrative
Stow multiplies demand by 0.80 (stowed) or 1.25 (unstowed or failed)
open_items: Workbook stow selector defect: Dashboard!G7 reads B7 instead of B8 (not patched in v1)
No cell-specific known-answer test fixture for v1
No claims or forensic calibration; v2.0 promotion is blocked pending independent review and stronger calibration
